title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - AutomotiveEntity
description: The main objects of interest in the automotive domain (s4auto:AutomotiveEntity). A generic automotive object exposing the position, shape, kinematic and environmental properties shared by vehicles, traffic participants, vulnerable road users, roadside equipment and other automotive objects in SAREF4AUTO. More specific SAREF4AUTO entities (Vehicle, TrafficParticipant, VulnerableRoadUser, RoadSideUnit, etc.) conceptually extend this generic type and repeat these common properties directly, since NGSI-LD has no formal entity-type inheritance.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AutomotiveEntity'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. WGS84 position, modeling s4auto:Position / s4auto:GeoPosition.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

shapeKind.description: Kind of shape used to describe the geometry: rectangularShape, circularShape, polygonalShape or ellipticalShape (s4auto:Shape).

height.description: Height of the shape/prism extending in the positive z-axis, in metres.

shape.description: Property. The shape of this automotive object (s4auto:Shape): a rectangular area/cuboid, circular area/cylinder, polygonal area/prism or elliptical area/cylinder.

heading.description: Property. Orientation of the horizontal velocity vector of the automotive object (s4auto:Heading), in degrees from WGS84 north or from a local Cartesian abscissa.

speed.description: Property. Magnitude of the automotive object's velocity vector (s4auto:Velocity3d), in m/s.

acceleration.description: Property. Magnitude of the automotive object's acceleration vector (s4auto:Acceleration3d), in m/s^2.

stationarySince.description: Property. Duration since which the automotive object has been stationary (s4auto:StationarySince).

automotiveObjectKind.description: Property. Whether the automotive object represents a single object, a group of multiple objects, or a bulk material (s4auto:AutomotiveObject_*).
